file: 324 Blox Fruits Used to Have a Different Name.mp4

lines.t: One of the biggest Roblox games ever used to have a different name. And it had to change it.

full.credit: Clips: WinterKloudz; Gamer Robot (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: When it came out in January 2019, it was called Blox Piece. Inspired by One Piece.

full.credit: Clips: WinterKloudz; Gamer Robot (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: By the end of 2019, it was renamed Blox Fruits, reportedly because of copyright pressure.

full.credit: Clips: WinterKloudz; Gamer Robot (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Today it has over 65 billion visits.

full.credit: Clips: WinterKloudz; Gamer Robot (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: And over 260,000 people were playing it when I checked.

full.credit: Clips: WinterKloudz; Gamer Robot (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)
